people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: Archites
people.line: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
